text.p: AccuStaff Inc said on Friday it had bought Computer Action Inc in a cash deal whose terms it did not disclose.
AccuStaff said the company, an information technology services firm based in Toronto, Ontario, would help it expand in Canada.

"We intend to continue to aggressively expand our presence in the U.S., Canada and in selected European markets," it said. "The acquisition pipeline is full and we expect to announce the completion of several more acquisitions soon, including both larger cash transactions and those in 'niche' markets."
Computer Action, with projected 1997 revenues totalling about $13 million, has banks, insurance firms, and oil companies as customers, it said.
Based in Jacksonbille, Florida, AccuStaff provides staffing, consulting and outsourcing services.
